reason: Rendered immediately after a <kbd>Esc</kbd> chip (SettingsSidebar.tsx), so the UI literally reads 'Esc 지우려면' — broken word order for '[Esc] to clear'. Natural Korean is '눌러서 지우기' (or reverse the order to '지우려면 Esc').

Standalone voice-style label ending in the possessive/attributive '-의' is not natural Korean UI copy. All sibling TTS style labels use adjective endings (밝은, 경쾌한, 단호한, 친근한...). '정보 전달형' or '유익한' fits the series.

'음성' and '보이스' are the same word (Konglish duplication); no native UI pairs them as 'X 및 X'. The section holds the TTS voice picker and speech-to-text model, so '음성 및 TTS' (or '음성 설정') reads naturally.
'Composer' rendered as '작성기' — a coinage Korean UIs never use for the chat input area. Use '메시지 입력창' or '입력창'.
Literal rendering of the unusual English 'Reading Size'; '읽기 크기' is not phrasing a native Korean UI would use. '본문 글자 크기' (or simply '글자 크기') is standard and matches the tooltip's description.

'추론' is the majority; unify on it unless Reasoning-mode and Thinking-level must remain visually distinct terms.

INCONSISTENCY: transcription = '전사' (voiceInputTranscribingAria, transcriptionFailedWithMessage '전사에 실패했습니다', suggestionAsrDesc, suggestionAsrShort, suggestionSrtDesc) vs '변환' (chatBehaviorVoiceModelLabel '음성 텍스트 변환 모델', chatBehaviorVoiceModelTooltip '텍스트로 변환하는 데 사용되는 모델'). '전사' is linguistic jargon many users won't parse at a glance; unify on '변환' (텍스트 변환).

INCONSISTENCY: Picture-in-Picture appears three ways — 'PIP 모드/PIP 창' (pipEnter 'PIP 모드 진입', pipExit 'PIP 모드 종료', pipPlaceholderTitle 'PIP 모드의 채팅', pipPlaceholderClose 'PIP 창 닫기'), 'Picture-in-Picture 모드' (helpCmdPip), and '화면 속 화면' (shortcutsTogglePip). Pick one (recommend 'PIP 모드', optionally introducing '화면 속 화면(PIP)' once) and apply everywhere.

INCONSISTENCY: 'Reset' = '초기화' (settingsReset '설정만 초기화', settingsApiProxyReset '초기화', filePreviewResetView / codeResetView '보기 초기화') vs '재설정' (settingsResetModelList, settingsLiveArtifactsSystemPromptReset '...재설정', shortcutsResetDefault '기본값으로 재설정', shortcutsResetAria '단축키 재설정'). INCONSISTENCY: identical source 'Export Chat' translated two ways — '채팅 내보내기' (exportChat, history item menu) and '대화 내보내기' (exportChatTitle, export dialog header). Unify on '채팅 내보내기' to match app-wide usage (새 채팅, 채팅 기록).

AMBIGUITY: 'Fetch' and 'Import' are both '가져오기' inside the same model-management flow — Fetch family: settingsFetchModelList '모델 가져오기', settingsFetchingModelList '가져오는 중...', settingsOpenAICompatibleFetchedPreviewTitle '가져온 모델', settingsOpenAICompatibleFetchedPreviewCount '가져온 {count}개 모델 중...', settingsOpenAICompatibleFetchedPreviewEmpty '모델을 가져와 미리보고 가져오세요.'; Import family: settingsOpenAICompatibleImportSelectedModels '선택 항목 가져오기', settingsOpenAICompatibleModelImportNoSelection '가져올 모델을 선택하세요.', settingsOpenAICompatibleModelImportAdded '{count}개 모델을 가져왔습니다.'. Two distinct actions share one verb. Reserve '가져오기' for Import (matches global import keys such as settingsImportHistory) and switch the Fetch family to '불러오기'.

Same English 'Total Duration' translated differently: '총 소요 시간' (metricsTotalDuration) vs '총 재생 시간' (review-screen label above the recorded clip length). '재생 시간' implies playback time while the value shown is the recording length.

INCONSISTENCY: 'Video' = '동영상' everywhere else (settingsFilesApiVideo, settingsMediaResolutionTooltip, videoSettingsTipFps, filePreviewYoutubePlayer, suggestionSrtDesc, tokenModalVideoEstimate) but '비디오' here and in settingsMediaResolutionLiveTooltip '비디오/오디오 해상도'. Unify on '동영상'.
'Even' describes an even/steady, near-monotone delivery; '차분한' means calm — related but shifted. '균일한' (or '일정한 톤') is accurate.
'흥분한' carries an agitated/negative nuance in Korean; for the upbeat 'Excitable' voice style '신나는' (or '들뜬') is the natural positive equivalent.
Drag-and-drop overlay copy chains two verbal nouns awkwardly ('놓아서 ... 업로드'); natural Korean overlay text is a conditional clause ('놓으면 ...됩니다').

STYLE INCONSISTENCY: all sibling suggestion-card subtitles end in '-합니다.' (suggestionSummarizeShort '핵심 주제를 빠르게 추출합니다.', suggestionOcrShort, suggestionExplainShort, suggestionAsrShort, suggestionSrtShort, suggestionHtmlShort); this one is a bare noun plus period.
